_about: Public-domain Ernest Naville (1816-1909), Genevan Reformed philosopher and apologist, for the Word Hoard: The Heavenly Father, lectures on modern atheism (1865), The Problem of Evil (1871), The Christ (1880) and Modern Physics (1884), in their English translations, from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 48 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

naville-heavenly-father: The heavenly Father : lectures on modern atheism (London : Macmillan, 1865)
naville-problem-of-evil: The problem of evil; seven lectures (Edinburgh, T. & T. Clark, 1871)
naville-the-christ: The Christ : seven lectures (Edinburgh : T&T Clark, 1880)
naville-modern-physics: Modern Physics, studies historical and philosophical, translated by Henry Downton (1884)

_excluded.naville-other: Every Egyptological title (Pithom, Saft el Henneh, the Todtenbuch): Édouard Naville, another man; French originals
